title: Adapter capability description
description: The document an adapter prints for `<adapter> describe --json`, declaring what it can measure and which result schema it emits per load mode. Authored by each adapter (adapters/kafkars/src/protocol.rs, crates/bench-adapter-librdkafka) and consumed by benchctl during the probe phase, which seals it into subjects.lock.json. Documentation mirror of the AdapterDescription serde type in crates/bench-schema/src/adapter.rs, which is the source of truth.

name.description: Adapter identity, for example kafkars or librdkafka-c.

version.description: Adapter version. For the librdkafka shim this is the pinned build version; the runtime rd_kafka_version stays in result.json.

capabilities.description: What this adapter supports. benchctl refuses to resolve an experiment a subject cannot express.

compression.description: Supported compression codecs, for example none, lz4, zstd.

completion_modes.description: Completion boundaries this adapter can observe, for example aggregate-batch-terminal.

ownership_modes.description: Payload ownership contracts this adapter can honor.

metric_families.description: Client-native metric families this adapter can emit.

result_schemas.description: Optional map from load mode to the schema id of the result.json this adapter writes in that mode.
